top_signals.title: CTO of ‘RansomwareHelp’ Indicted for Wire Fraud
top_signals.summary: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com, a six year old Florida business that claimed to use "advanced cryptographic tools" to restore data locked by ransomware, has been charged with wire fraud after an FBI sting operation found the company was simply paying the attackers for a decryption key and charging victims a markup for work that was never performed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: ConocoPhillips to Exit Norway in $4.43 Billion Deal with Vaar Energi
top_signals.summary: Vaar Energi has agreed to buy ConocoPhillips’ Norwegian business in a $4.43 billion deal that includes Ekofisk, the field that launched Norway’s oil era, and stakes in some of the country’s largest gas fields. Vaar Energi said Monday it had agreed to acquire interests in 13 producing fields and related infrastructure in Norway and the United Kingdom. The portfolio includes the Greater Ekofisk Area, stakes in Troll, Heidrun, Oseberg and Aasta Hansteen, and the Teesside oil terminal in northeast England. The sale would end ConocoPhillips’…

top_signals.summary: The month-long selloff unleashed by Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s surprise re-election victory continued to rattle markets on Monday as investors retreated amid escalating doubts about his commitment to reining in the government’s swelling debt.
